# Results — Study 189 (Double-Top / Double-Bottom) on real daily tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py).  Detection of the
classic M-shaped double-top and W-shaped double-bottom chart-reversal patterns on
daily OHLCV bars; confirmation at the neckline break (close below the intervening
trough for a double-top, close above the intervening peak for a double-bottom).
Forward returns measured at 1-day, 5-day, and 20-day horizons and pinned against a
random-day placebo (same tape, same direction, unconditional base rate).  As-of
**2026-06-15**; data source Yahoo Finance daily bars 2010-01-01 to 2026-06-15.*

*Ticker basket: SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, JPM, XOM, GLD, IWM (10 names,
4,137 trading days each).  Detection parameters: min\_bars = 10, tolerance = 4%,
lookback = 120 bars, atr\_prominence\_mult = 0.5.*

## Pooled pattern results (cost = 0 bps, pooled across 10 tickers)

| Pattern | Horizon | n | Win% | Signal (bps) | Placebo (bps) | Excess (bps) | HAC t (excess) | HAC t (signal) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| double_top    | 1d  |   905 | 49.7% |   +5.64 |   −4.76 | +10.40 | +1.39 | +1.05 |
| double_top    | 5d  |   902 | 42.8% |  −36.70 |  −35.30 |  −1.40 | −0.09 | −3.27 |
| double_top    | 20d |   898 | 35.4% | −159.70 | −120.61 | −39.08 | −1.27 | −6.18 |
| double_bottom | 1d  | 1,322 | 55.8% |  +11.40 |  +10.88 |  +0.51 | +0.10 | +3.41 |
| double_bottom | 5d  | 1,320 | 57.0% |  +18.78 |  +29.50 | −10.72 | −0.88 | +2.39 |
| double_bottom | 20d | 1,317 | 61.9% | +104.68 | +111.78 |  −7.09 | −0.28 | +6.30 |

**Bonferroni threshold for 6 tests at α = 5%: |t| ≥ 3.0.**

**Key findings:**

- **Double-top (bearish reversal):** The 1-day excess is nominally positive (+10.4 bps,
  t = +1.39) but the wrong sign for the bear thesis and below the significance threshold.
  The 5-day excess is noise (t = −0.09).  The 20-day signal mean is significantly negative
  (t = −6.18) — but the 20-day *excess* is only t = −1.27, meaning the market was already
  in a downtrend when the double-top fired; the pattern adds nothing over a random bearish
  bet at the same time.  No horizon clears the inference bar on excess returns.

- **Double-bottom (bullish reversal):** The signal mean at 5d and 20d is positive and
  statistically significant (t = +2.39, +6.30) — but the *excess over the placebo* is
  negative at every horizon (−10.72 bps at 5d, t = −0.88; −7.09 bps at 20d, t = −0.28).
  The market was already trending upward when the double-bottom fired; the pattern adds
  no information beyond the unconditional bullish drift of equities.

- **Bonferroni correction:** Zero of the six excess t-stats survive the |t| ≥ 3.0 threshold.
  The maximum excess |t| across all tests is 1.39.

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.**  No pattern / horizon combination produces a statistically significant
  excess return over a random-day placebo after Bonferroni correction.  The maximum HAC
  |t| on excess is 1.39 (double-top, 1-day).  The absolute signal means at longer horizons
  reflect general market direction at the time of pattern formation, not pattern-specific
  forecasting power.

- **Tradability — MIRAGE.**  Signal is absent on the excess axis, and costs further reduce
  an already-noise-level expected return.  Even a 1 bps round-trip cost applied to the
  double-bottom 5-day arm produces a net excess of −12.72 bps, making execution impossible
  at any positive cost.  Survivorship bias (patterns detected only on names that survived
  to 2026) named but not quantified; it would make the result look *better*, not worse, so
  the honest excess estimate is if anything generous to the pattern.
